lightning-01.notes: Both counters and i-dot are visible. Guided branching channels and soft corona, stylized rather than a calibrated plasma simulation.

lightning-02.notes: Angular original silhouette, separate l/i, bright channel structure contained mostly within the strokes.

fire-01.notes: Turbulent interior flame structure remains; counters, l/i gap and i dot are open. Earlier unbounded combustion obscured the mark; uniform depth flow looked flat. Authored oxidizer boundary resolved the two requirements.

earth-01.decision: retain revised relief; full render still to review
earth-01.notes: Closed fragments, visible surface relief and self-shadowing, counters and l/i preserved. Depth enlarged for chunkier release geometry; exact silhouette retained.

water-01.hold: Reviewed at 3.2s and 4s, plus formation at 1s and 2s
water-01.notes: Original silhouette and counters preserved, i dot separate, moving clear-water reflections with thin liquid surface. Broad studio highlights remain on the outside Cs. Native volume balance zero and pressure convergence below 1e-5. Release still rendering.

user-review.reason: New materials significantly worse than accepted original bending effects; stop ongoing renders. Confinement produces stencil, sheet and plaque appearance. Return to accepted material renderers and adapt motion/emission only.
